query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "uniclawbench: a universal benchmark for proactive agents on real-world" linguistics
rationale: The paper focuses on computer vision (remote sensing image dehazing) and lacks any connection to the user's domain of Large Language Models (LLMs), proactive agents, or linguistics. It fails all inclusion criteria (a-f) as it addresses a distinct construct in an entirely different field, satisfying only the rejection rule for "off-domain entirely."
